caption: The drawing features a single, detailed object: an old-fashioned lantern. The lantern is depicted vertically on a plain, off-white background. It has a large circular handle at the top attached by a small metal hook, which connects to the conical, riveted cap of the lantern. Below the cap, the main body of the lantern consists of a transparent section with visible glass panels shaped into a bulbous form, enclosed by multiple thin, evenly spaced vertical metal wires forming a protective cage. Inside the glass body, the base is circular and contains the fuel reservoir and the burner. The drawing uses pencil shading, resulting in various tones of grey and black to illustrate the metallic and glass components, and employs fine lines and hatching to define the textures and contours of the lantern. There is no background detail apart from the lantern, focusing all attention on the central object. Near the lower left corner, there is a small handwritten signature or text.
title: Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
